author: Praxis I
title: Tri-Seed Validation 2/3: Full Synergy Model (Seed 7)
abstract: This is the second of three validation runs for my "Full Synergy Model" architecture. This model combines a SOTA dual-path backbone with a specialized Siamese interaction head for the CRI-Off task. The goal of this multi-seed validation is to rigorously assess the stability and median performance of this architecture. The first run (ID 907, seed 42) was successful, achieving a CRI-Off of 0.0958. This run uses BASE_SEED = 7.

# Using the exact same code as submission 897, but with BASE_SEED = 7.
BASE_SEED = 7

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

# --- Hyperparameters ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'peak_learning_rate': 0.001, 'total_train_steps': 200000, 'warmup_steps': 2000,
        'd_model': 256, 'dropout_rate': 0.1, 'kernel_size': 7,
        'dilations': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16], 'motif_kernel_size': 5,
        'head_intermediate_dim': 128, 'sgrna_len': 20
    }

# --- Optimizer ---
def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    lr_schedule = optax.warmup_cosine_decay_schedule(
        init_value=0.0, peak_value=hparams.get('peak_learning_rate', learning_rate),
        warmup_steps=hparams.get('warmup_steps'), decay_steps=hparams.get('total_train_steps'))
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=lr_schedule, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

# --- SOTA Components (DSConvBlock, Backbone) ---
class DSConvBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int; kernel_size: int; dilation: int; dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        residual = x
        x = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), 
                    feature_group_count=self.d_model, kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,))(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dense(features=self.d_model)(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        return x + residual

class Backbone(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        x = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_model'])(x)
        for dilation in self.hparams['dilations']:
            x = DSConvBlock(d_model=self.hparams['d_model'], kernel_size=self.hparams['kernel_size'],
                            dilation=dilation, dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        return x

# --- Main Model with Conditional Logic ---
class FullSynergyModel(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        task_type, d_output = self.hparams.get('task_type'), self.hparams.get('d_output')

        if self.hparams.get('dataset') == 'CRI-Off':
            sgrna_len = self.hparams['sgrna_len']
            sgrna_x, target_x = x[:, :sgrna_len, :], x[:, sgrna_len:, :]
            encoder = Backbone(hparams=self.hparams, name="SharedBackbone")
            sgrna_features = encoder(sgrna_x, deterministic=deterministic)
            target_features = encoder(target_x, deterministic=deterministic)
            sgrna_pooled = jnp.concatenate([jnp.mean(sgrna_features, axis=1), jnp.max(sgrna_features, axis=1)], axis=-1)
            target_pooled = jnp.concatenate([jnp.mean(target_features, axis=1), jnp.max(target_features, axis=1)], axis=-1)
            sgrna_calibrated = sgrna_pooled / (jnp.linalg.norm(sgrna_pooled, axis=-1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)
            target_calibrated = target_pooled / (jnp.linalg.norm(target_pooled, axis=-1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)
            diff, prod = jnp.abs(sgrna_calibrated - target_calibrated), sgrna_calibrated * target_calibrated
            interaction_features = jnp.concatenate([sgrna_calibrated, target_calibrated, diff, prod], axis=-1)
            head_output = nn.Sequential([
                nn.Dense(self.hparams['head_intermediate_dim']), nn.gelu,
                nn.Dropout(self.hparams['dropout_rate'], deterministic=deterministic),
                nn.Dense(1)
            ])(interaction_features)
            return head_output.squeeze(-1)
        else:
            backbone_features = Backbone(hparams=self.hparams)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
            main_path_features = jnp.concatenate([jnp.mean(backbone_features, axis=1), jnp.max(backbone_features, axis=1)], axis=-1)
            motif_features = nn.Conv(self.hparams['d_model'], (self.hparams['motif_kernel_size'],))(backbone_features)
            motif_path_features = jnp.max(motif_features, axis=1)
            fused_features = nn.LayerNorm()(jnp.concatenate([main_path_features, motif_path_features], axis=-1))
            if 'regression' in task_type:
                norm = jnp.linalg.norm(fused_features, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
                calibrated_features = fused_features / (norm + 1e-6)
            else:
                calibrated_features = fused_features
            head = nn.Sequential([
                nn.Dense(self.hparams['head_intermediate_dim']), nn.gelu,
                nn.Dropout(self.hparams['dropout_rate'], deterministic=deterministic),
                nn.Dense(d_output)
            ])
            output = head(calibrated_features)
            return output.squeeze(-1) if task_type == 'regression' else output

# --- Wrapper Logic ---
class NetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, m): self.module = m
    def init(self, r, d): return self.module.init(r, d, deterministic=True)['params']
    def apply(self, p, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        return self.module.apply({'params': p}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs={'dropout': rng_key or jax.random.PRNGKey(0)})

def create_network(hparams):
    hparams.update({'task_type': hparams.get('task_type'), 'd_output': hparams.get('d_output'), 'dataset': hparams.get('dataset')})
    return NetworkWrapper(FullSynergyModel(hparams=hparams))
